description: This file contains API functions related to organizations, including listing organizations and fetching organization summaries. It exports functions that interact with backend endpoints to retrieve data about organizations (tenants), their usage, and navigation details.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches and returns a sorted list of organizations (tenants) with normalized IDs and names from the backend endpoint '/session/tenants'.

methods.name: getOrganizationSummary(tenantId)
methods.description: Builds and returns a summary of an organization, including ID, name, total cost, and user count, by querying usage and navigation endpoints for a specified tenant.
